propositions: The rebar plan vocabulary carries vestigial split headings (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria) for one concept; every criterion that uses them pools and applies a single bar, making the heading name carry no semantic load.

Success Criteria items are written as plain bullets and do not count toward the P1 blocking floor, cannot carry the [operator-attested] tag, and are not individually checkable, while Acceptance Criteria use checkboxes counted by _count_ac_items.

Collapsing Success Criteria into Acceptance Criteria across detectors, prompts, routing index, guides, eval specs, tests, and 106 store tickets requires a sequenced expand-contract migration to maintain reviewability during the transition.

Four acceptance criteria were initially unsatisfiable due to contradictions with the epic's own Scope, child story AC6, the mechanics of regenerated artifacts, and unowned scope gaps; remediation added explicit carve-outs for dod_uncertifiable, plan_review_T2.md, completion.py, and O-RAN-SC to make the epic completable.
